subject: Evaluation delivery & acceptance roadmap — Navis MAP and dataset exchange
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@navis.ai>, John Lee <john.lee@navis.ai>
Cc: procurement@navis.ai
Date: 2025-08-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Evaluation delivery & acceptance roadmap — Navis MAP and dataset exchange

Hi Samira / John,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our call, attached is the initial mutual action plan and the artifacts we propose to deliver for the evaluation: a prompt pack (promptpack_v3.zip), a manifest with sample counts (navis_eval_manifest.csv), and the MAP draft (MAP_Draft_Navis_v2.pdf). The goal here is a short, instrumented evaluation so your engineers can validate latency/accuracy and our platform team can verify integration.

High-level proposed timeline:
- Aug 18: Redwood delivers obfuscated prompt pack + manifest to a Navis sandbox (s3 pre-signed link).
- Aug 19–22: Navis runs acceptance tests (regression + QA harness).
- Aug 25: Final acceptance sign-off or list of regressions; begin one-week remediation if needed.

Usage constraints we are proposing (please review):
- Artifacts are provided under a limited evaluation license: sandbox-only, non-production.
- No redistribution or external sharing.
- Prompts/testcases may be watermarked and are for acceptance testing only.
- Data and artifacts must be deleted 90 days after transfer unless a written extension is agreed.
- Redwood will provide ephemeral API tokens limited to the sandbox environment.

Can you confirm: (1) Navis legal/procurement contact to route the MAP and MPA to, (2) whether an on-prem staging environment is required, and (3) any additional acceptance gates you need in the MAP?

Attachments: MAP_Draft_Navis_v2.pdf (MAP draft), promptpack_v3.zip (zipped prompt/testcases, obfuscated), navis_eval_manifest.csv (sample manifest)

Thanks — I’ve looped in Kimberly and Rishi to help with legal/ops details.

—Avery
Avery Johnson
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0139

From: Samira Khan <samira.k@navis.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@navis.ai, John Lee <john.lee@navis.ai>
Date: 2025-08-17T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation delivery & acceptance roadmap — Navis MAP and dataset exchange

Thanks Avery — quick clarifying items from our side before we route to procurement/legal: 

1) Retention: Navis requires a shorter retention for third-party artifacts — can Redwood do 30 days by default, with a documented exception process for longer retention?
2) On-prem: We prefer to run the acceptance tests in our internal staging (air-gapped) for sensitive data. Can you provide an on-prem-friendly delivery (SCP/secure courier) or do we need the sandbox-only path?
3) Audit rights: We need a narrow audit window (one 2-hour session) to verify no data egress during the test.
4) SOC2 evidence: procurement wants a SOC2 attestation or an equivalent checklist for your data handling.

If you can confirm those four items and send a finalized MPA link, we’ll aim to turn this around quickly. Also attaching our evaluation requirements tracker for reference (we’ll share it with procurement).

Best,
Samira
Head of ML Ops, Navis AI
samira.k@navis.ai

Attachment referenced: Navis_eval_requirements.xlsx (not attached here — will share with procurement)

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira.k@navis.ai>
Date: 2025-08-17T12:18:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Evaluation delivery & acceptance roadmap — Navis MAP and dataset exchange

Kimberly / Rishi — forwarding Samira’s asks. Can you review and propose concise redlines we can accept without broadening legal exposure? Key asks: 30-day retention default (Navis prefers), on-prem delivery option, narrow audit window, SOC2 evidence.

Suggested internal approach:
- Offer 30-day default retention for evaluation artifacts; allow documented extension to 90 days with approvals from Redwood Legal + Redwood CSM.
- On-prem delivery: provide an encrypted archive with checksums; for air-gapped verification we can offer an offline media option under an SOW.
- Audit window: accept one scheduled 2-hour observation with an engineer present and non-intrusive tooling.
- SOC2: provide our SOC2 type II summary + a short control-mapping doc for the evaluation (can be generated in 48 hours).

Also thinking about product controls: ship only a 10k-record subsample in the prompt pack for the initial run and provide a watermarked prompt header to prevent any accidental reuse. We can offer a one-week credit (waived) if Navis runs into integration blockers to keep momentum.

Can you draft the minimal MAP redlines and confirm whether we can accept the audit language? I’d like to stay firm on deletion and non-redistribution.

—Avery

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira.k@navis.ai>
Date: 2025-08-18T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Evaluation delivery & acceptance roadmap — Navis MAP and dataset exchange

Thanks — reviewed. Proposed redlines summarized below (I’ve attached a redlined MAP PDF for their review):

1) Retention: agree to 30-day default retention. Extension to 90 days must be requested in writing 7 days prior to expiry and requires Redwood Legal approval and a scoped SOW for longer storage; we will add automated deletion verification (hash tombstone) and provide a deletion confirmation email.

2) On-prem delivery: agree in principle to provide encrypted archive and checksum; for air-gapped environments Redwood will provide a sealed USB/SSD under chain-of-custody and a 3-business-day lead time; this will be captured as an optional SOW item.

3) Audit rights: accept a single, scheduled two-hour observation with Navis engineers present and no live debugging/execution allowed; Redwood will provide read-only logs and a staff engineer to observe.

4) SOC2: provide SOC2 Type II summary + a 1-page control mapping specifically for the evaluation. We can deliver the mapping in 48 hours and the attestation copy within 3 business days.

5) Artifact scope & acceptance: ship a curated 10k-record seed and an obfuscated promptpack for acceptance only. Acceptance criteria will be a 3-rule checklist: (a) regression pass on canonical test cases (b) latency within agreed thresholds on the sandbox tokens (c) no evidence of prompt leakage in logs. Failure to meet criteria yields a one-week remediation window; after remediation, if still failing, either party may terminate the MAP and artifacts must be destroyed.

6) IP / usage: narrow license to "Evaluation Only" — no derivation, no production use, no commercializing of testcases. We will watermark prompts and embed a per-run header token.

I’ve kept the language tight to avoid mission creep. Once Samira confirms, I’ll prepare the DocuSign-ready MPA and add the SOW clause for the on-prem option.

Attachment: MAP_Draft_Navis_v2.pdf (redline)

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@navis.ai>, procurement@navis.ai, John Lee <john.lee@navis.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-08-20T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Final: Navis evaluation delivery plan, MAP and next steps (DocuSign link included)

Samira / Navis procurement — thanks for the quick back-and-forth. Per Kimberly’s redlines below, we’ve adjusted the MAP to reflect the 30-day default retention, on-prem delivery option as an SOW, the single audit window, and the acceptance checklist.

Next steps (proposed):
- Aug 21 EOD: Navis confirms procurement/legal contact and whether they want the on-prem SOW option.
- Aug 22: Redwood uploads encrypted artifact bundle to a pre-signed staging URL (or ships media if on-prem requested).
- Aug 22–26: Navis runs acceptance tests.
- Aug 27: Acceptance sign-off or remediation list.

I’ve attached the final MAP redline and included a DocuSign link for signature: https://docusign.example.com/MPA-Navis-ND2319 (internal link stub). Attachments will include promptpack_v3.zip (obfuscated, 10k seed), navis_eval_manifest.csv, and the signed MPA once completed.

If that timeline works I’ll schedule a brief sync for Monday to walk the Navis engineers through the manifest.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the trial underway.

—Avery
